description: This is a Java test class for the CsrfUtil utility in the org.apache.ofbiz.security package. It contains unit tests for various CSRF protection functionalities such as token retrieval, URL modification, and request mapping logic.

classes.name: CsrfUtilTests
classes.description: This class contains JUnit test methods to verify the functionality of CSRF-related utility methods in the CsrfUtil class.

methods.name: testGetTokenMap
methods.description: Tests retrieval of CSRF tokens from session, with and without userLogin present.

methods.name: testGetRequestUriWithSubFolderLimit
methods.description: Tests URI processing with subfolder limits applied in CsrfUtil.

methods.name: testGetRequestUriFromPath
methods.description: Verifies extraction of request URI from various URL path formats.

methods.name: testGenerateTokenForNonAjax
methods.description: Tests token generation for non-AJAX requests, including handling of request map configurations.

methods.name: testFindRequestMapWithoutControlPath
methods.description: Tests mapping logic for various request URIs to predefined request map entries.

methods.name: testGenerateTokenForAjax
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of CSRF token for AJAX requests.

methods.name: testGetTokenForAjax
methods.description: Tests retrieval of CSRF token stored in session for AJAX.

methods.name: testAddOrUpdateTokenInUrl
methods.description: Tests URL modification to add or update CSRF token as URL parameter.

methods.name: testAddOrUpdateTokenInQueryString
methods.description: Tests query string modification to add or update CSRF token parameter.
